additions.name: Rechenzentrum Alteno — planned hyperscale data centre (B-Plan Nr. 04.1.02, Industriegebiet Alteno)

status.summary: The Stadt Luckau published on 23 September 2026 its official notice of the Aufstellungsbeschluss for Bebauungsplan Nr. 04.1.02 „Ergänzung zum Bebauungsplan Nr. 01 Industriegebiet Alteno“, the Einleitungsbeschluss of the 14th amendment of its land-use plan and the early public participation. The council (Stadtverordnetenversammlung) took both items on 27 August 2026 (Vorlagen V Stvv/26/029 and 030). The Vorlage states that a hyperscale data centre is to be built within the in-force B-Plans Nr. 01 and 01a „Industriegebiet Alteno“, for which the Landkreis Dahme-Spreewald issued a positive preliminary decision on 7 March 2025, and that the new plan adds about 1.5 ha on Flurstück 44/1 to create one building field; the state DiPlanung portal lists the public participation period for the 14th land-use plan amendment as 12 October to 12 November 2026. Announced status only: a B-Plan Aufstellungsbeschluss and a preliminary building decision are not a building permit, and no building permit, Federal Immission Control Act permit or physical work is established.

locator.precision: Centroid of the union of cadastral parcels Alteno Flur 1 Flurstück 44/1 (15,530 m2) and Flurstück 192 (45,810 m2), the two parcels on which the city places the plan area of B-Plan Nr. 04.1.02 to form one contiguous building field for the data centre (about 6.1 ha together, about 370 by 250 m). It locates the named development parcels, not a building footprint, the 110-kV switching station, the 2 ha plan area alone or the full extent of the other undeveloped plots of B-Plans 01 and 01a that the developer may also use.
locator.identity_review: Council Vorlage V Stvv/26/029 puts the B-Plan 04.1.02 area on Flurstück 44/1 and part of Flurstück 192, Flur 1, Gemarkung Alteno, for the hyperscale data centre; its Anlage 2 plan sheet labels 44/1 and 192 inside the boundary, and the DiPlanung Informationsblatt repeats both parcel numbers and the Frederik-Ipsen-Straße access. Brandenburg ALKIS returns exactly one Flur 1 parcel 44/1 (15,530 m2) and one Flur 1 parcel 192 (Frederik-Ipsen-Straße, 45,810 m2); parcels 44/3 (Flur 1) and 44 and 192 in Flur 2 and 44 in Flur 3 are excluded. The DiPlanung change-area polygon of the 14th FNP amendment covers 98 percent of parcel 44/1 and lies at the east edge of the union, its centroid 116 m east of the selected point. No ALKIS building stands on either parcel. The centroid lies inside the union.
locator.uncertainty_reason: ALKIS publishes no positional accuracy for the parcel boundaries; the point is a derived interior point of a 6.1 ha two-parcel union whose vertices lie up to 217 m away, and the data-centre buildings' positions are not published. The Vorlage says the data centre also uses undeveloped parts of B-Plans 01 and 01a without identifying them, so the building field may extend onto adjoining industrial parcels.
